'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Steve Skilton LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
